### CALIFORNIA BANCORP ANNOUNCES INCREASE IN SHARE REPURCHASE PROGRAM


November 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/192956001/files/doc_news/CALIFORNIA-BANCORP-ANNOUNCES-INCREASE-IN-SHARE-REPURCHASE-PROGRAM-2026.pdf)


San Diego, Calif., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- California BanCorp (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: BCAL), the holding company for California Bank of Commerce, N.A. (the “Bank”), announces that its Board of Directors has authorized an additional 1.6 million shares of the Company’s common stock that may be repurchased pursuant to its share repurchase program. The program was originally approved by the Board in June 15, 2023 and was most recently amended on May 1, 2025. As of November 3, 2026, approximately 557,315 shares remained available under the existing authorization. Since the program’s inception, the Company has repurchased 1,042,685 shares of the Company’s common stock for an aggregate purchase price of $19.7 million. The 1.6 million additional shares authorized for the repurchase represent approximately 5.0% of the Company’s outstanding shares of common stock.


“Our strong earnings and capital position provide us with the capacity to continue returning capital to shareholders through share repurchases, which we believe are an effective way to return capital and enhance long-term shareholder value. The expansion of our share repurchase program reflects the confidence of our Board of Directors and management team in our relationship-based banking strategy, and our continued commitment to delivering sustainable, longer-term value for our shareholders,” said David Rainer, Chairman of the Company and the Bank.


Repurchases under the program may occur from time to time in open market transactions, in privately negotiated transactions, or by other means in accordance with federal securities laws and other restrictions. The Company intends to fund its repurchases from available working capital and cash provided by operating activities. The timing of repurchases, as well as the number of shares repurchased, will depend on a variety of factors, including price; trading volume; business, economic and general market conditions; and the terms of any Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted by the Company. The repurchase program has no expiration date and may be suspended, modified, or terminated at any time without prior notice.


**ABOUT CALIFORNIA BANCORP**


California BanCorp (NASDAQ: BCAL) is a registered bank holding company headquartered in San Diego, California. California Bank of Commerce, N.A., a national banking association chartered under the laws of the United States (the “Bank”) and regulated by the Office of Comptroller of the Currency, is a wholly owned subsidiary of California BanCorp. Established in 2001 and headquartered in San Diego, California, the Bank offers a range of financial products and services to individuals, professionals, and small to medium-sized businesses through its 14 branch offices including 12 commercial banking offices serving California. The Bank’s solutions-driven, relationship-based approach to banking provides accessibility to decision makers and enhances value through strong partnerships with its clients.
